question:
**Direction: Select the option that gives the most appropriate meaning of the following word.**

Colossal
solution:
The correct answer is **"Mighty."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Colossal"** means extremely large or great in size, extent, or degree. (अतिविशाल, वृहत्‍काय, बहुत बड़ा)

 
 
• **Example:** *They were asking for a **colossal**__ amount of money for the house.*
 
 
 
• **"Mighty" **means very strong or powerful. (महाबली, पराक्रमी, अतिशक्तिशाली)
 __
 
• **Example:** *In the next game they will face the **mighty**__ Patriots.*
 
 
 
• ​Therefore,* *the option that gives the most appropriate meaning of the following word is **"Mighty."**
 
• The correct answer is Option 3.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Irrelevant **means not connected with or relevant to something.
 
• **Authentic** means of undisputed origin and not a copy; genuine.
 
• **Appropriate** means suitable or proper in the circumstances.
